item.title: Secondary-Shell Phosphorus Engineering of Fe Single-Atom Catalysts for Efficient Electro-Fenton Oxidation
item.description:
این مقاله با بازیافت سرباره استخراج لیتیوم از باتری‌های مستعمل LiFePO4، کاتالیزور تک‌اتمی Fe-PNC ساخته و با تنظیم فسفر پوسته دوم، تولید رادیکال هیدروکسیل در الکترو-فنتون را بهبود می‌دهد.
ACS Catalysis | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in upcycling spent LiFePO4 battery slag into a phosphorus-modulated Fe single-atom catalyst, with P placed in the secondary coordination shell to electronically tune FeN4 sites. This enhances the three-electron oxygen reduction pathway for efficient ·OH generation, boosting tetracycline degradation and outperforming Fe-NC by 3.3-fold. It offers a sustainable waste-to-catalyst route with lower environmental impact than homogeneous electro-Fenton.
🏷 single-atom catalyst · electro-Fenton · phosphorus modulation · LiFePO4 recycling · hydroxyl radical

💡 The novelty lies in a "nano-friction-strengthening" strategy: core-shell nanoparticles in a carbonate-swollen shell activate dynamic hydrogen bonds under impact, boosting interparticle friction and viscosity 160-fold for impact hardening. This cuts impact force by 73.1%, preventing short circuits in pouch cells, while phosphate-ester groups suppress thermal runaway, enabling safer lithium metal batteries under mechanical abuse.

item.title: Concentration‐Dependent Li‐Ion Solvation and Dual‐Interphase Regulation by Cyanuric Chloride in Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries
item.description:
افزودنی سیانوریک کلرید در غلظت 0.05 مولار، ساختار حل‌پوشی Li+ و فازهای بین‌سطحی را در باتری Li-S تنظیم کرده و پایداری چرخه و ظرفیت را بهبود می‌دهد.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Cyanuric chloride is introduced as a concentration-tunable additive for Li-S batteries, with 0.05 M optimal. It enhances anion participation in Li-ion solvation, suppresses polysulfide crossover, and forms dual inorganic-rich interphases at cathode and anode. This yields 3000-cycle stability, 560 mAh g⁻¹ at 10C, and 72.73% pouch-cell retention, while showing that excess additive (0.10 M) degrades performance—highlighting concentration-dependent design.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · cyanuric chloride · solvation structure · dual interphase · polysulfide

item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in integrating a MoSe₂/TiF₄ heterojunction into PEO to create a built-in electric field that simultaneously accelerates Li⁺ transport and promotes LiTFSI dissociation via Lewis acid-base interactions. This dual-function strategy yields high ionic conductivity (1.09×10⁻⁴ S cm⁻¹), a Li⁺ transference number of 0.55, and stable cycling, offering a viable pathway for practical solid-state lithium-metal batteries.

item.title: Hyperconjugation‐Mediated Design of Dissolution‐Resistant Organic Cathode for Durable Zinc‐Ion Batteries
item.description:
طراحی ابرهم‌یوغی کووالانسی در کامپوزیت TAPT@rGO، انحلال کاتد آلی را سرکوب کرده و ظرفیت 271 mAh g−1 با پایداری چرخه‌ای عالی در باتری آبی Zn یون فراهم می‌کند.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a hyperconjugation-mediated design covalently integrating TABQ and PTD with graphene oxide to form a nitrogen-extended conjugated framework (TAPT@rGO). This synergy boosts electronic conductivity and suppresses dissolution. Significance: the cathode delivers 271 mAh g⁻¹ at 0.1 A g⁻¹, 0.8 V average voltage, and 82.5% retention over 10000 cycles, offering a rational molecular strategy for durable organic AZIB cathodes.
🏷 zinc-ion battery · organic cathode · hyperconjugation · dissolution resistance · TAPT@rGO
